values.note: The price depends on the hookups at the site, whether used or not. A stay of 7+ nights pays for 6 of every 7. Dump station $5 for registered campers. No refunds; changes $10 each, and cancelling 10+ days out leaves an account credit.

fees.source: https://www.clarkcountywi.gov/for-parks-rock-dam ('Campsites range from $24 to $37 per night.'); Campground Policies & Rules PDF ('There is a $10.00 reservation fee applied to each reservation'; 'per amenities present at the selected site regardless of use'; 'One camping party shall consist of no more than eight persons'; 'Registered campers are charged $5 fee for dump station use'; 'Refunds are not offered.'); Extended Stay policy ('Extended Stay Campers will be charged for 6 out of their 7 nights stayed (15% Discount).'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Sites 1-150 plus 128A. Most have water and electric, a row near the office has full hookups, and a few have no electric. Sites in roughly the western half (about 84-150) are ATV sites with trail access; the eastern loops (1-83) are not.

facilities.source: https://www.clarkcountywi.gov/for-parks-rock-dam (Features: '2 Shower Houses', 'Convenience Store', 'Drinking Water', 'Flush Toilets', 'Sanitary Dump Station'); campground map legend ('Laundry'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Full service May 1 - Sep 30. October-April is self-registration, 3 nights at a time, with very limited facilities and access not guaranteed; a heated shower building stays open through the nine-day gun deer season.

season.source: https://www.clarkcountywi.gov/for-parks-rock-dam ('Self-registration camping is available throughout the remainder of the year but please note that campground facilities are extremely limited during this time and we cannot guarantee access during these months. values.note: Clark County WebTrac, or by phone to the Forestry and Parks office. Bookings open January 1 for the same calendar year only and close 3 days before arrival; within 3 days every unreserved site is first come, first served. Check-in 3 PM, check-out 1 PM.

summary: Clark County page, campground map and county policies read (WebTrac refused): $24-37 confirmed, $10 reservation fee, 8 people max; 149 sites (water/electric, some full hookups); 2 shower houses, store, laundry, dump; reservable May 1-Sep 30 (2-night minimum, 28-night max), self-registration off-season -> year_round with note. Half the sites are ATV sites: OHV flag. Not waterfront kept.
flags: OHV: the county calls it 'a hub area for forest based recreation. ATV enthusiasts can enjoy immediate campsite trail access, with a wide variety of trail riding experiences.' The map marks roughly the western half of the sites (about 84-150) as ATV sites; the eastern loops (1-83), the beach, boat launch and lake side are non-ATV. Reads as a general lake campground with an ATV side, but the reviewer decides.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Rock Dam Lake lies east of Butler Rd, across the road from the nearest sites (30-38); Hay Creek along the north edge is a narrow stream under continuous canopy on Esri imagery.
